name: Silicon-controlled rectifier
summary: An SCR is a thyristor with a gate-controlled triggering function in its documented circuit.
description: An SCR is a thyristor with a gate-controlled triggering function in its documented circuit. Anode, cathode and gate connections must be distinguished to understand the control path.
readingNotes: Read turn-on and current-interruption behaviour from the chosen circuit and component.
The preview is an original explanation of this function. Match the actual drawing convention to its legend and the selected equipment documentation.
distinction: An SCR is not the same as a bidirectional TRIAC.
